focus_organization.4: Rich real or imagined event/sequence with actions, thoughts, feelings and dialogue, time words and closure.
focus_organization.3: Well-developed event/sequence with actions, thoughts and feelings, time words and closure.
focus_organization.2: Poor sequence, unclear or insufficient detail, inconsistent time words or closure.
focus_organization.1: Unclear sequence without details, time words or closure.

conventions.2: Use simple/compound sentences, suitable capitalization and spelling, commas and apostrophes for contractions/possession; errors are not systematic.
conventions.1: Errors can obscure meaning; inconsistent punctuation, capitalization or spelling.

scope_notes: Publication version is not established by the source catalog.
